description: Client half of XH's Hoist toolkit: React + MobX, element-factory components, HoistModel and HoistService, ag-Grid grids, forms, dashboards, persistence, routing. Pairs with hoist-core.
rules: Render components with element factories (panel({...}), grid({...})) rather than JSX. Pass children via item/items and use the omit prop for conditional rendering.
v88+ uses TC39 decorators: @bindable accessor name, @observableRef, @bindableRef, no makeObservable. Through v87: plain fields (@bindable name = null) plus makeObservable(this) in the constructor.
Use creates(ModelClass) when a component owns its model, uses(ModelClass) when a parent supplies it. lookupModel and @lookup work only in linked models, from onLinked on.
Mark child HoistBase instances @managed so they are destroyed with their owner. Use this.addReaction() and this.addAutorun(), not raw MobX reaction() or autorun().
Implement doLoadAsync(loadSpec) and trigger it with loadAsync() or refreshAsync(), never directly. Pass loadSpec through to XH.fetchJson and nested loads.
Reach services and app-wide APIs through XH (XH.fetchJson, XH.configService, XH.toast, XH.handleException). App services extend HoistService and install via XH.installServicesAsync.
Use Hoist input components (textInput, numberInput, select, checkbox, dateInput, textArea) bound to FormModel fields through formField. Do not use raw HTML inputs.
Grid columns are plain ColumnSpec objects in GridConfig.columns. Try the pre-built column specs and @xh/hoist/format renderers (numberRenderer, dateRenderer) before a custom renderer.
Import from package barrels (@xh/hoist/core, @xh/hoist/cmp/grid, @xh/hoist/desktop/cmp/panel, @xh/hoist/mobx), never from internal files or impl folders.
Use null, not undefined, as the no-value sentinel and test with == null. Suffix promise-returning methods with Async.
v86+: wrap async work in the Runner chain, e.g. this.runner(ctx).span('loadX').linkTo(task).track({...}).run(async ctx => ...) or .fetchJson(). Compose masking, tracking, and spans there.
Pick the Context7 version that matches the app's @xh/hoist version. Across majors, read docs/upgrade-notes/v<major>-upgrade-notes.md and docs/version-compatibility.md.
